narrative.shortDescription: Rain-darkened pilings creak where black river-barges unload bewildered arrivals beneath swinging tallow-lanterns.
narrative.overview: Rain-darkened pilings creak where black river-barges unload bewildered arrivals beneath swinging tallow-lanterns.

hiddenSpots.name: Shattered Brass Tally
hiddenSpots.text: Wedged between wet quay planks you pry loose a stamped brass tally bearing half a forgotten seal.

narrative.shortDescription: Row upon row of slate desks groan under ledgers while pale clerks stamp arrival writs by the hiss of ash-lamps.
narrative.overview: Row upon row of slate desks groan under ledgers while pale clerks stamp arrival writs by the hiss of ash-lamps.

hiddenSpots.name: Misfiled Debt Slip
hiddenSpots.text: Behind an overturned inkwell lies a folded audit slip showing phantom border requisitions.

narrative.shortDescription: Canvas awnings shelter spice-boilers, scrap-smiths, and memory-peddlers hawking wares over crackling braziers.
narrative.overview: Canvas awnings shelter spice-boilers, scrap-smiths, and memory-peddlers hawking wares over crackling braziers.

hiddenSpots.name: Dropped Toll-Purse
hiddenSpots.text: Tucked beneath an awning post rests an unclaimed apothecary salve.

narrative.shortDescription: A warm, soot-stained tenement run by retired ferrymen where unstamped souls trade rumors over hot barley broth.
narrative.overview: A warm, soot-stained tenement run by retired ferrymen where unstamped souls trade rumors over hot barley broth.

narrative.shortDescription: Half-submerged jetties rot in oil-slick mist where smugglers cache contraband and river-scavengers prowl at dusk.
narrative.overview: Half-submerged jetties rot in oil-slick mist where smugglers cache contraband and river-scavengers prowl at dusk.

hiddenSpots.name: Waterlogged Charter Tube
hiddenSpots.text: Inside a barnacled brass cylinder you find a pre-Chancery river charter sealed in wax.

narrative.shortDescription: Colossal brass retorts hiss and shudder as gangs of indebted laborers shovel pale soul-ash into blazing furnaces.
narrative.overview: Colossal brass retorts hiss and shudder as gangs of indebted laborers shovel pale soul-ash into blazing furnaces.

hiddenSpots.name: Pure Crucible Slag
hiddenSpots.text: Beneath a cooling chute you salvage a shard of dense, ember-veined crucible slag.

narrative.shortDescription: Towering iron shelving stretches into vaulted gloom, holding three centuries of soul-contracts, tax-rolls, and sealed decrees.
narrative.overview: Towering iron shelving stretches into vaulted gloom, holding three centuries of soul-contracts, tax-rolls, and sealed decrees.

hiddenSpots.name: Altered Conscription Roll
hiddenSpots.text: Between duplicate binders you discover proof that Frontier casualty tallies were deliberately inflated.

narrative.shortDescription: Hydraulic presses strike gleaming toll-coins stamped with twin scales while armed bailiffs watch every doorway.
narrative.overview: Hydraulic presses strike gleaming toll-coins stamped with twin scales while armed bailiffs watch every doorway.

narrative.shortDescription: Bronze chimes hang above quiet cobblestones around the monastery foundry of the Order of the Last Bell.
narrative.overview: Bronze chimes hang above quiet cobblestones around the monastery foundry of the Order of the Last Bell.

hiddenSpots.name: Consecrated Bell-Bronze
hiddenSpots.text: Near the quenching trough sits an ingot of resonant consecrated bell-bronze.

narrative.shortDescription: Echoing brick culverts carry warm ash-runoff beneath the Lower City, frequented by fugitives and mutated gutter-hounds.
narrative.overview: Echoing brick culverts carry warm ash-runoff beneath the Lower City, frequented by fugitives and mutated gutter-hounds.

hiddenSpots.name: Cutpurse Grate Cache
hiddenSpots.text: Wired behind a rusted sluice valve sits a waxed roll of fine locksmith picks.

narrative.shortDescription: Polished obsidian steps ascend past gilded ash-braziers where senior magistrates and aristocratic creditors debate the price of eternity.
narrative.overview: Polished obsidian steps ascend past gilded ash-braziers where senior magistrates and aristocratic creditors debate the price of eternity.

narrative.shortDescription: A domed hall of leaded glass where thousands of luminescent memory-phials chime softly in warm drafts.
narrative.overview: A domed hall of leaded glass where thousands of luminescent memory-phials chime softly in warm drafts.

hiddenSpots.name: Unlabelled Amber Phial
hiddenSpots.text: Behind a cracked cabinet pane glows a sealed vial of pure distilled memory.

narrative.shortDescription: Curtained galleries where debt-syndicates bid on expired tallies and patricians sip luminous longevity elixirs.
narrative.overview: Curtained galleries where debt-syndicates bid on expired tallies and patricians sip luminous longevity elixirs.

narrative.shortDescription: Massive brass pendulums swing in deafening rhythm, timing the city's curfew chimes and hiding a secret gear-chamber above the dial.
narrative.overview: Massive brass pendulums swing in deafening rhythm, timing the city's curfew chimes and hiding a secret gear-chamber above the dial.

hiddenSpots.name: Thirteenth Chime Plate
hiddenSpots.text: Clipped behind the thirteenth gear tooth lies a tarnished brass relay key.

narrative.shortDescription: Terraced pits of grey chalk and fossilized bone descend beneath timber cranes where debtors haul ash-ore in chains.
narrative.overview: Terraced pits of grey chalk and fossilized bone descend beneath timber cranes where debtors haul ash-ore in chains.

hiddenSpots.name: Exposed Pale-Iron Vein
hiddenSpots.text: In a collapsed quarry gallery you pry loose raw pale-iron ore.

narrative.shortDescription: Beehive brick ovens belch amber sparks across blackened heath, guarded by Furnace Guild enforcers and soot-constructs.
narrative.overview: Beehive brick ovens belch amber sparks across blackened heath, guarded by Furnace Guild enforcers and soot-constructs.

hiddenSpots.name: Overflow Cinder-Pitch Sump
hiddenSpots.description: Beneath a forgotten cooling grate, thick black-gold Cinder-Pitch Resin has pooled in sealed clay jars.

narrative.shortDescription: Patchwork tents huddled against a basalt ridge where exhausted quarry workers share scraps and whisper of rebellion.
narrative.overview: Patchwork tents huddled against a basalt ridge where exhausted quarry workers share scraps and whisper of rebellion.

narrative.shortDescription: A skeletal iron railway bridge spans a choking ash-gorge, patrolled by Frontier Wardens watching the pale mist below.
narrative.overview: A skeletal iron railway bridge spans a choking ash-gorge, patrolled by Frontier Wardens watching the pale mist below.

hiddenSpots.name: First Frontier Salt-Charm
hiddenSpots.text: Tied to a fallen iron stanchion hangs a weathered bone salt-charm.

narrative.shortDescription: An underground reservoir lit by stolen blue tallow-lamps where Unstamped Freebooters trade frontier gear and safe passage.
narrative.overview: An underground reservoir lit by stolen blue tallow-lamps where Unstamped Freebooters trade frontier gear and safe passage.

narrative.shortDescription: A stark basalt fortress crowned with blazing ash-beacons marking the last boundary of Chancery authority before the endless salt-frontier.
narrative.overview: A stark basalt fortress crowned with blazing ash-beacons marking the last boundary of Chancery authority before the endless salt-frontier.

narrative.shortDescription: Blinding crusts of white mineral stretch to a horizon of drifting gray fog, littered with half-buried standards from forgotten ages.
narrative.overview: Blinding crusts of white mineral stretch to a horizon of drifting gray fog, littered with half-buried standards from forgotten ages.

hiddenSpots.name: Second Frontier Salt-Charm
hiddenSpots.text: Half-fused into a salt pillar gleams a carved glass frontier charm.

narrative.shortDescription: Stacked stone markers shift position whenever the fog thickens, humming with stray memories shed by wandering souls.
narrative.overview: Stacked stone markers shift position whenever the fog thickens, humming with stray memories shed by wandering souls.

narrative.shortDescription: Jagged plains of lightning-vitrified ash sing in the wind like broken harps; luminous essence pools in the craters.
narrative.overview: Jagged plains of lightning-vitrified ash sing in the wind like broken harps; luminous essence pools in the craters.

hiddenSpots.name: Fulgurite Ash-Quartz
hiddenSpots.text: From a smoking fulgurite spire you snap free a crystal of humming ash-quartz.

narrative.shortDescription: Pale reed-fens bubble with warm mist that echoes half-remembered mortal lullabies and conceals ravenous mire-wraiths.
narrative.overview: Pale reed-fens bubble with warm mist that echoes half-remembered mortal lullabies and conceals ravenous mire-wraiths.

hiddenSpots.name: Third Frontier Salt-Charm
hiddenSpots.text: Resting atop a sunken skiff prow lies an unbroken silver-wire frontier charm.

narrative.shortDescription: A cathedral carved from calcified mist-stone where the Court of the Unwritten holds solemn audience beneath starless vaults.
narrative.overview: A cathedral carved from calcified mist-stone where the Court of the Unwritten holds solemn audience beneath starless vaults.

narrative.shortDescription: An arched causeway of ivory stone suspended over a roaring canyon of grey cloud, defended by altered sentinel knights.
narrative.overview: An arched causeway of ivory stone suspended over a roaring canyon of grey cloud, defended by altered sentinel knights.

narrative.shortDescription: Rows of stone tablets and wax cylinders preserve the true history of the Threshold before the Chancery ever minted a coin.
narrative.overview: Rows of stone tablets and wax cylinders preserve the true history of the Threshold before the Chancery ever minted a coin.

hiddenSpots.name: Architect's Uncut Tablet
hiddenSpots.text: Inside a hollow lectern rests the Silent Architect's original design of the First Seal.

narrative.shortDescription: Translucent trees drip resinous tears that preserve dying vows in amber, watched over by a grieving transformed Warden.
narrative.overview: Translucent trees drip resinous tears that preserve dying vows in amber, watched over by a grieving transformed Warden.

hiddenSpots.name: Weeping Amber Tears
hiddenSpots.text: You gather glowing drops of weeping amber from the oldest glass-trunk.

narrative.shortDescription: Colossal basalt piers frame a dry riverbed of floating dust where the very first crossing barges once departed into true silence.
narrative.overview: Colossal basalt piers frame a dry riverbed of floating dust where the very first crossing barges once departed into true silence.

narrative.shortDescription: A subterranean cistern of obsidian mirrors where stolen centuries of mortal memory swirl like trapped storm-clouds.
narrative.overview: A subterranean cistern of obsidian mirrors where stolen centuries of mortal memory swirl like trapped storm-clouds.

narrative.shortDescription: A circular bridge of black iron surrounding a colossal brass balance that weighs every soul arriving in Vesper-Threshold.
narrative.overview: A circular bridge of black iron surrounding a colossal brass balance that weighs every soul arriving in Vesper-Threshold.

narrative.shortDescription: At the silent heart of the Threshold stands a monolithic silver ring bound in Chancery chains: the fractured seal that governs rest or eternal toll.
narrative.overview: At the silent heart of the Threshold stands a monolithic silver ring bound in Chancery chains: the fractured seal that governs rest or eternal toll.

narrative.shortDescription: A soot-stained timber slipway tucked between the Customs Hall and the Foundries, where an independent hearth still burns untaxed coal. Hanging brass calipers clink in the mist above Master Artisan Orla's open forge.
narrative.overview: A soot-stained timber slipway tucked between the Customs Hall and the Foundries, where an independent hearth still burns untaxed coal. Hanging brass calipers clink in the mist above Master Artisan Orla's open forge.

hiddenSpots.name: Tarnished Quench-Trough Cache
hiddenSpots.description: Beneath a pile of rusted tongs lies a tin of oiled brass mainsprings salvaged before Baron Vane's embargo.

narrative.shortDescription: Collapsed slag galleries descending beneath the Debt-Quarries. Warm amber fissures of fossilized Cinder-Pitch resin and vitrified Kiln-Glass pulse softly in the dark while chitinous scuttlers scrape behind cooling slag columns.
narrative.overview: Collapsed slag galleries descending beneath the Debt-Quarries. Warm amber fissures of fossilized Cinder-Pitch resin and vitrified Kiln-Glass pulse softly in the dark while chitinous scuttlers scrape behind cooling slag columns.

hiddenSpots.name: Vitrified Kiln-Glass Seam
hiddenSpots.description: A glassy blue-orange seam sheared clean by ancient furnace heat yields razor-pure Tempered Kiln-Glass.

narrative.shortDescription: A listing tower of salt-fused basalt and cracked brass domes overlooking the Pale Reach. Before the Chancery stamped its first ledger, star-watchers tracked the tides of the Threshold here; static lightning still welds silver veins along the broken spire.
narrative.overview: A listing tower of salt-fused basalt and cracked brass domes overlooking the Pale Reach. Before the Chancery stamped its first ledger, star-watchers tracked the tides of the Threshold here; static lightning still welds silver veins along the broken spire.

hiddenSpots.name: Cracked Astrolabe Drawer
hiddenSpots.description: Inside a velvet-lined brass drawer rests an unblemished Mnemonic Prism-Shard ground to refract lantern light.

narrative.shortDescription: A vaulted catacomb lined with dozens of bronze bells bound in lead chains so they can never ring again. The Chancery interred these pre-Toll bells after their chimes freed indebted spirits, leaving a tireless brass sentinel to guard the silence.
narrative.overview: A vaulted catacomb lined with dozens of bronze bells bound in lead chains so they can never ring again. The Chancery interred these pre-Toll bells after their chimes freed indebted spirits, leaving a tireless brass sentinel to guard the silence.

hiddenSpots.name: Chained Choir Alcove
hiddenSpots.description: A fractured pre-Chancery bell lip hums faintly in your palm, shedding dust of ancient Muted Bell-Alloy.
